text: Hello and welcome to this live text commentary of the Premier League match between Brentford and Manchester City!
City's title hopes were boosted on Sunday when Arsenal beat title rivals Liverpool, meaning Pep Guardiola's champions will go top, ahead of the Reds, if they win both of their two games in hand.
Both of those are against Brentford, starting here in west London.
The treble winners will be only too aware of the threat Brentford pose.
They did the double over City last season and could become the first opponents to deal Guardiola three straight top-flight defeats in his coaching career.
City have not lost three in a row to the same team since December 2016 and a fourth consecutive league loss to Liverpool.
Let's get the team news...
Brentford make only one change from the team narrowly beaten by Tottenham as Reguilon comes in for his full debut, having been unable to feature against his parent club.
City's injury woes have eased up considerably, allowing Guardiola to name something approaching his strongest side.
Haaland makes his first start in almost two months, looking for a first goal against Brentford, the only Premier League team he has faced without scoring.
KICK-OFF: De Bruyne gets the game under way!
Early nerves for City! Toney leads a Brentford counter and twice plays balls from the right into a dangerous area.
Maupay does well to reach the first but is closed down, then Dias is first to the second, only to awkwardly nod behind for a corner in front of Ederson.
It is clear that first attack followed the Brentford game plan.
Whenever they get possession, they are looking early for Toney or Maupay in behind.
Both men could prove a real nuisance.
De Bruyne is starting to get involved.
Played in by Silva, his cross is too close to Flekken, but the midfielder soon gets another opportunity and picks out Haaland, whose shot is blocked.
Alvarez draws the save! Gvardiol cuts inside and fizzes a pass across the edge of the box to the forward, who controls and then looks to curl a shot inside the near corner.
It looks destined for the top corner until Flekken gets across to make a viital stop.
City keep the pressure on following their corner, with Dias going down and appealing for a penalty before the ball breaks to Gvardiol, whose shot is deflected wide.
A quick check from the VAR clears Collins following his challenge on Dias.
City briefly look to be in trouble! Toney races through and the offside flag stays down until he shoots straight at Ederson.
The forward had strayed beyond the last man, although it was tight.
Another Flekken save! Again from Alvarez! Haaland tees up his strike partner, who shapes a fine effort towards the bottom-right corner, requiring Flekken to smartly turn the ball around the post.

Flekken again! This is perhaps the most testing of the three so far for the Brentford goalkeeper, seeing Walker drive in a shot from distance that moves as it approaches the target and needs a strong right hand to save once more.
Brentford are yet to register a shot of any kind, while City have worked Flekken on three occasions.
Brentford now look to push the visitors back the other way.
City work a crossing opportunity following a half-cleared corner, with Alvarez's delivery nodded only as far as Gvardiol on the edge of the box.
But the defender hacks at a left-footed shot and clears the crossbar by some distance.

GOOAAALLLL!!! MAUPAY! 1-0 BRENTFORD ON THE BREAK! City are completely caught out by a long ball down the centre of the pitch, with the visiting defenders expecting Toney to get a touch and allowing Maupay to instead race in behind.
The forward keeps his cool and squeezes a low finish into the bottom-left corner.
The goal comes directly from Flekken's goal-kick.
Toney perhaps impedes Ake, but he cannot be offside from a goal-kick, meaning Maupay is also in the clear when his strike partner dummies the ball instead of making contact.
HUGE SAVE! Haaland is denied! Flekken's flurry of early saves was relatively routine, but he has to be at his best to keep Haaland out.
A loose Brentford pass lets the superstar striker in, but he cannot emulate Maupay at the other end and is halted by a big right foot from Flekken.
City keep pushing, looking for a swift response, but Alvarez's stooping header is optimistic at best and easily gathered by a grateful Flekken.
Flekken is there again! Walker is fortunate to have the ball break his way on the right, allowing the right-back to cut a cross back.
It reaches Gvardiol on the far side, with the City man deciding to take a touch rather than shooting first time.
He still has time to hit the target with a powerful effort, but Flekken is a match for it once more.
The shot count now stands at 10-1 in City's favour.
However, Flekken has made six saves, while Brentford's only attempt found the net!
Walker feeds Alvarez with a cute pass into the box, but the Argentina international snatches at the shot and finds only the hands of Flekken again.
Maupay lunges in on Rodri, missing the ball and catching his opponent's foot.
It is an obvious yellow card for the goalscorer.
Brenford are furious as City really get away with one! Ederson races out to meet a sloppy pass that almost lets Toney in, yet the City goalkeeper very nearly heads straight to a Brentford player.
Indeed, Janelt is first to it, so Silva dives in and leaves the Brentford man in a heap.
The home crowd want a foul, although it looks to be a good challenge, preventing Janelt from shooting towards an empty goal.
City attack with Janelt still down, eventually seeing Silva closed down and firing over.
With the ball out of play, Janelt is belatedly able to receive treatment.
Janelt is able to continue after a brief stoppage.
Jensen's long throw into the box earns a Brentford corner, which the same man take and puts on Toney's head inside the six-yard box.
The header is deflected over, with Toney apparently believing he had done enough to worry Ederson.

Reguilon almost catches Ederson out! Brentford's latest corner goes short, and a teasing cross bounces straight through the box and is destined for the far corner until Ederson belatestly reacts to parry.
Gvardiol blasts across the face of goal! The defender continues his run after laying the ball off to De Bruyne, who lifts a delightful pass over the Brentford defence back to his team-mate.
It is not clear if Gvardiol is going for goal or looking for a team-mate, but he finds neither.

Ederson is living dangerously! Again he makes a mess of his clearance, this time when he should be able to handle inside his own box, but the return shot cannot reach the vacant goal as Dias blocks from Reguilon.
Flekken deserves that fortune! Foden fires in a low shot that is close to the foalkeeper and should allow him to save comfortably, but the power almost beats him.
Flekken spills the ball, which spins just wide.
Flekken saves again! What a half he has had! De Bruyne cuts inside and goes alone, shooting towards the far corner but finding the goalkeeper again standing firm.
There will be a minimum of three minutes of added time, with City still on the front foot as Silva's shot is deflected wide in front of Flekken.

GOOAAALLLL!!! FODEN! 1-1! There is nothing Flekken can do about this one! The goalkeeper is completely wrong-footed when Pinnock's weak header only reaches Foden on the penalty spot, from where he fires low into the net.
City have the equaliser their performance deserves.
Big challenge from Collins! City seek a quick second and De Bruyne breaks before firing a cross towards Haaland.
The City man looks favourite to get there, but Collins recovers admirably to clear ahead of the half-time whistle.
HALF-TIME: Brentford 1-1 Manchester City
Both teams might wonder how they are not ahead as the sides head in at 1-1 at half-time.
Brentford battled to protect the lead given to them by Maupay, with goalkeeper Flekken making a phenomenal nine saves to keep his team ahead.
But just as it looked as though they had reached the interval in front, Pinnock's error allowed Foden to level, and City will now look to go on and win this game.
Flekken has been at the centre of everything.
He has had the joint-most touches of any Brentford player (28), and it was from his goal-kick that Brentford scored.
That was the first goal assisted by a goalkeeper in the Premier League this season.
KICK-OFF: Jensen restarts the action.
It is all City at the start of the second half.
Brentford need to regain a foothold after that equaliser.
Just as in the first half, Brentford are looking to play on the counter.
There is a brief opportunity when Reguilon twice times a tackle well on the edge of his own box and Maupay is then given the freedom of the left flank.
He cannot work the ball into a shooting position, though.
City are getting their own opportunities to break when Brentford attack, but the final pass is just missing, as it is at the other end when Toney's cross is headed away by Ake.

GOOAAALLLL!!! FODEN AT THE DOUBLE! CITY HAVE TURNED IT AROUND! 2-1! This is not a typical Foden goal, a header as he ghosts into the box and nods just beyond the grasp of Flekken, finding the bottom-right corner to put City in control.
The marking is disappointing from Brentford, but it takes a player of the quality of De Bruyne to pick out Foden, his inch-perfect cross creating the opportunity.
Back come Brentford.
Reguilon's searching pass looks to find Toney before Ake stretches to divert the ball towards Roerslev.
The onrushing Brentford player lashes at the opportunity, failing to worry Ederson.
Flekken hangs on as De Bruyne's shot from outside the box earns a deflection and almost loops over the goalkeeper.
De Bruyne is serenaded by the City fans after an extended period of pressure wins a corner, which the midfielder takes.
It does not trouble Brentford this time, though.
The home side are just about still in the game.
BIG BLOCK! Dias keeps Brentford out! This is why City cannot afford to grow complacent, with Brentford retaining a threat.
Toney peels away to the back post and sees his volley deflected off Ake and straight into the path of Norgaard.
He looks certain to score, but Dias lunges to block brilliantly.
Norgaard is there again from a left-wing corner, but his header is across the face of goal without a touch from either a team-mate or an opponent.
Now Gvardiol blocks! A corner reaches Maupay at the back post, and his volley is goalbound until the defender gets his body in the way.
City come forward again, with Rodri running through the Brentford midfielder and finding space to shoot, only to place his finish too close to Flekken from outside the box.
Brentford are such a threat every time they come forward.
Toney is the centre of attention, but his presence creates space for team-mates.
Another cross evades the forward but runs instead for Roerslev, who gets in a bit of a muddle with Maupay and the chance is gone.
Now Toney gets a chance of his own, picked out for a volley just inside the area, but his first-time effort clears the crossbar.
FODEN HAT-TRICK!!!! THREE FOR CITY, THREE FOR FODEN! 3-1! That should be the game as Foden gets beyond the last defender with a little shimmy and then coolly slots past Flekken.
He has ultimately been the difference in this game.
Still no goal for Haaland against Brentford, but he collects an assist with a cute lay-off that lets Foden run onto the ball and finish with ease.
This is not what Brentford might have wanted after going 3-1 down.
Doku is on, replacing Silva.
City are keeping the ball with ease, now not even giving Brentford the opportunity to counter.
It may be up to the champions to decide whether they want to pursue further goals.
Brentford make a triple-change to try to shake things up, introducing Yarmoliuk for Janelt.
Roerslev is off for Lewis-Potter on the wing.
Brentford also take off Jensen for the creative Damsgaard.
Norgaard meets another Brentford corner from the left but this time his header is straight into the hands of Ederson.
Lewis-Potter gets in behind Gvardiol for the first time, but he does not look up before crossing and drills straight at Ederson with no team-mates close enough in support.
Reguilon has impressed in what looks to be a losing effort, but he is replaced by Ajer.
Ederson comes for a free-kick on the edge of the box but does not get there and instead wipes out Pinnock.
No foul is given, and the incident occurs outside the penalty area, so the goalkeeper escapes punishment as a City break is halted at the other end.
There is a pause in play as the referee speaks to both Walker and Maupay separately, with the City captain seemingly upset with something said to him by the Brentford forward.
There is no punishment for either man.
Alvarez fires in a snapshot that Flekken has to hold, with Haaland failing to find Doku in the centre moments earlier.
City are probing again.
De Bruyne fizzes wide! Doky reaches the byline and crosses to De Bruyne, who meets the ball on the volley but just misses the bottom-right corner.
Haaland will not get his goal as Guardiola introduces Kovacic in his place.
Brentford just cannot keep the ball, while City very much can.
The champions are so accomplished at seeing out matches and are doing so again here.
There will be a minimum of five minutes of added time.
Maupay's opener feels a long time ago now as he makes way for Baptiste.
Walker's loose header gives Brentford a corner and one last chance to attack, but they cannot make the most of it and are soon scrambling back to halt the counter.
FULL-TIME: Brentford 1-3 Manchester City
Manchester City climb back up to second and now within two points of leaders Liverpool with a 3-1 win at Brentford.

Meetings with the Bees were tough for the champions last season and threatened to test them again when Maupay scored first, but City dominated and deserved this ultimately comfortable victory, secured through Foden's treble.
It could and perhaps should have been more, and Liverpool will be feeling the pressure as City still have a game in hand.
They face Everton at home next, while Brentford go to Wolves.
That is all from this game, though.
Thanks for joining us, and until next time, goodbye!
